answer: A concrete sybil defense is a counterparty-diversity check: an identity only earns full reward weight after completing paid jobs with at least ten unrelated counterparties, and rewards between wallets funded from the same source are discounted to zero. A farm of fakes trading among itself looks like a hollow ring on the funding graph, so each clone must win real outside customers. A comet-bright burst of new accounts earns nothing, while an honest agent's steady, velvet-smooth record grows trust over time.
